name: Popcorn Prank
summary: You’ll come across a box of popcorn just sitting there, and the fun begins when you interact with it! Once you take action, giant popcorn will start popping out of the box at an incredible rate, quickly filling the entire room with fluffy kernels. The chaos of popcorn spilling everywhere makes for a light-hearted, immersive experience—perfect for a quick laugh prank or a stress-free moment.
